bible_verses.english: Let everything that has breath praise Yahweh! Praise Yahweh!
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been slain to receive power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, my blessed Redeemer and Good Shepherd, I offer You my praise today. Thank You for carrying me in Your loving arms and protecting me through every trial. You are worthy of all honor, strength, and glory, both in heaven and on earth. Help me to live each moment in joyful gratitude, trusting Your gentle care and proclaiming Your wonderful love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, my blessed Redeemer and Good Shepherd, I offer You my praise today. Thank You for carrying me in Your loving arms and protecting me through every trial. You are worthy of all honor, strength, and glory, both in heaven and on earth. Help me to live each moment in joyful gratitude, trusting Your gentle care and proclaiming Your wonderful love. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: "Praise Him, Praise Him!" invites us to join both creation and the heavenly host in exalting our Redeemer, Jesus. Yet, the supreme Lord who commands the praises of archangels is also the tender Shepherd who holds us gently in His arms. In every season of life, His strength shields us and His love guides our footsteps. As we lift our voices today, may our hearts rest securely in His watchful care and yield Him the honor He alone deserves.
